time_authority: Known application instants are canonical UTC whole seconds.
America/Guayaquil governs ordinary operational and SLA calendar interpretation unless a specific authority says otherwise.
Objective/Task selectable IANA timezone is scheduling/presentation context only and does not reinterpret import, communication, audit, SLA or other-domain chronology.
Occurrence/effective time and audit recording time are distinct facts whenever both exist.
Unknown external/effective chronology remains unknown rather than being replaced by recording/import/discovery/current time.
